event_chain.summary: Global information systems and order processing disrupted

summary: On Tuesday, August 25, 2026 Boston Scientific detected a cybersecurity incident that disrupted access to its global information systems and business applications, particularly order processing and shipping. It activated incident response, hired outside specialists and moved to phased restoration; more than 7,000 employees at its Irish sites in Cork, Clonmel and Galway were affected, and the company later said it was unlikely to meet its 2026 forecast. It did not disclose whether data was compromised, the method or the actor.
